label: Holodeck Productization — Local-First
goal: Turn the repository's workspace and Holodeck capability into a local-first, self-hosted product that can safely coordinate autonomous development in arbitrary repositories.
purpose: Discover and define the smallest reusable product boundary, validate it against a real external repository, and prepare an evidence-backed implementation plan.
success_condition: A validated v1 product contract, installation path, safety model, pilot evidence, and sequenced implementation plan exist without committing to hosted multi-tenant operation.
objectives: Define the generic runtime boundary and separate it from Inner World-specific adapters.
Specify a zero-to-working local installation experience for an arbitrary repository.
Validate the lifecycle on a non-Inner-Space pilot repository.
Define the safety, approval, evidence, and recovery guarantees required for bounded autonomy.
scope_out: Unattended production deployment or credential mutation.
Replacing existing Inner World product behavior before a migration plan is approved.
Any claim that autonomous development can resolve ambiguous product decisions without escalation.
